title: WNBA PRA Repair V1 Step 2 — Page 2 Team-ID Repair
scope: Page-2 canonical identity, cold Game Center readiness, and fail-closed player-control identity containment above the frozen WNBA PRA runtime. Preserve the frozen Game Center/model math while preventing contradictory cross-team player IDs from reaching globally keyed Streamlit controls.
root_cause: Merged-main production proof reached GAME CENTER READY with 31 players, proving the cold-load repair worked, then crashed with StreamlitDuplicateElementKey during player-control rendering. The frozen Step-9 duplicate-key guard deduplicated player IDs only within each team, while Game Center and Step-8 preview keys are global to the page and based on player_id. A player ID claimed by both teams can therefore survive Step 9 and collide globally.
patch: After the frozen Step-9 within-team dedupe, scan all selected-game team groups for player IDs claimed by more than one team. Fail closed by suppressing every row carrying a cross-team-conflicting player ID from all teams, recalculate the player count, and expose suppression diagnostics. Do not guess team ownership and do not alter projection, market, probability, qualification, ranking, or sportsbook math.

recovery.prior_public_observation: GAME CENTER READY • 31 players • Dallas 16 players
recovery.key_contract: Game Center and Step-8 controls are globally keyed by player_id
recovery.frozen_step9_gap: dedupe scope was per-team, not selected-game global
recovery.resolution: suppress all rows for player IDs claimed by multiple teams before player controls render
